generalCriterionList.description: Tenders from Joint ventures are acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Tenderers are required to read the Bid Documents carefully before submission of their bid

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted
Any discrepancies observed in the documents uploaded by the tenderer the tender shall liable to rejected

As per Karnataka State Government order No.LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore Dated 01.01.2007 and Government Letter No.PW/134/BMS/2007 Dated 27-07-2007, a sum amounting to 1%of the bill amount will be deducted towards Construction Labour Welfare fund
The Employer reserves the right to reject any or all Tenders without assigning any reason or what so ever
The earnest money deposit will be forfeited if the documents submitted by the tenderer found to be misleading/forged or fake
Financial weightage for previous years shall be given a weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the 2026-27
Turnover certificate from CA with valid UDIN No. to be furnished along with necessary documents
Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt., orders as may be modified from time to time
Bidder has to quote rates excluding GST, GST shall be paid separately as per applicable
All the Work done certificate uploaded should include E-procurement indent number
Tenderer has to quote same rates for the items which are repetitive in all sub estimates, if any discrepancies lowest rates will be considered

Joint venture is acceptable, maximum 02 joint ventures members( prime and JV partner) are allowed. All partners of the Joint Venture shall be legally liable, jointly and severally, during the tendering process and for the execution of the contract in accordance with the contract terms, and a statement to this effect shall be included in the authorization mentioned in the format of JV Agreement of Section 10
In case of JV, the members of JV shall associate with only one bidder for the same work. Multiple association is not allowed

technicalCriterionList.description: To qualify for award of this contract, The intending bidder can submit bids as an Individual / joint venture bidder should have in the last five years i.e., 2021-22 to 2025-26, Satisfactorily completed (at least 90% of the contract value), as prime contractor, at least one similar work such as UGD project /I&D project/ water supply project/Lift - Irrigation Projects /Storm Water Drains/combined water supply & sewerage project/ combined water supply or Sewerage project with Road/ combined water supply or Sewerage project with Layout works/ combined water supply or Sewerage project with Building works of value not less than Rs 384.50 Lakhs during the last 5 financial years (2021-22 to 2025-26),The certificate should be issued by an officer not below the rank of the Executive Engineer or Equivalent or Employer in case of Govt / Semi Govt. Authorities and General Manager in case of public sector Undertaking.( If the bid is submitted as joint venture, then any one partner/jointly should meet the requirement)

The tenderer or his identified electrical-contractor should possess valid Class-II and above electrical license and should have executed similar electrical works totalling to Rs. 6.30 Lakhs in any one year of the last five years (2021-22 to 2025-26),If the bid is submitted as joint venture, then any one partner/jointly should meet the requirement.

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder should furnish the Class-I Registration Certificate of any State/Central-Government/Public-Sector Organization issued by competent authorities

To qualify for award of this contract, the intending bidder can submit bids as an Individual / joint venture bidder should have in the last five years i.e., 2021-22 to 2025-26, achieved in at least two financial years a minimum financial turnover (in all classes of civil engineering construction works only) of Rs.1537.90Lakhs. If the bid is submitted as JV, then the requirement of minimum financial turnover shall be considered on the basis of combined resources. The lead partner should have an annual financial turnover of not less than 51% of total turnover & JV member not less than 25% of total turnover indicated above in any two financial years and Combining should meet 100% during last 5 financial years (2021-22 to 2025-26). All document/ certificates issued by a Charted Accountant should have a UDIN (unique document Identification Number) generated through the ICAI (The Institute of chartered Accountants of India) Portal. Certificate without UDIN the documents uploaded will be considered and treated as invalid document. Attached are copies of financial statements (Auditors Report, Profit and Loss Statements, Balance Sheets, Form 240 of Sales Tax Returns / GST Annual Returns in the state of Karnataka & Relevant documents whichever is applicable in respective states, including all related notes and income statements) for the last FIVE Years.

If the bid is submitted as joint venture, then any one partner/jointly should meet the requirement, Note: Liquid asset in the form of credit line/ letter of credit/ certificates from banks for meeting the fund requirement etc., shall be in the format appended with the bid document. Any conditional Banker Certificate will not be accepted and will lead to disqualification.

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Package No-16 Design, Build, Operate and Transfer (DBOT) of Interception and Diversion work in Madhugiri ULB of Tumkur District with 5 years operation and maintenance (including 2 year Defect liability period) under Swachh Bharat Mission (Urban) 2.0 fund

itemList.description: PART- A(i):Design, supply, construction, installation, testing & commissioning of Interception and Diversion (I&D)Unit including components but not limited to SS screens, Interception weir/barrier, side retaining wing walls, diversion drains, inlet chambers, Gravity Main pipeline connecting from inlet chamber to Proposed Wetwell at Madhugiri TMC as per specification(indicative) and drawings(indicative) as per bid document and relevant IS codes, Including all lift and lead charges etc., As per the Instructions of Engineer-in-charge.

PART- A(ii):Design, supply, construction, installation, testing & commissioning of Wet Well with Electromechanical components such as Nonclog Sewage Pump sets and EOT crane, electrification, testing & Commissioning of Transformer and Other Developmental works such as Boundary Fencing, Entry Gate, Area Lighting, Approach Road, etc., at wet well premise works  as per specification (indicative) and drawings(indicative) as per bid document and relevant IS codes, Including all lift and lead charges etc., As per the Instructions of Engineer-in-charge.

PART- A(iii):Design, supply, construction, installation, testing & commissioning of Pipeline for length as per site condition requirements, of Ductile Iron (K9 class) pipe (Pumping Main) connecting from Proposed Wet Well of I&D - 1 to STP including Road Restoration works as per specification(indicative) and drawings (indicative) as per bid document and relevant IS codes, Including all lift and lead charges etc., As per the Instructions of Engineer-in-charge.

PART-B:Operation & Maintenance of the facility for 5 years:Operation & Maintenance of Interception and Diversion Structure and Wetwell Structures and all other supporting facilities/ Infrastructure works built up under the package contract excluding power charges, but including manpower cost, all repair cost, establishment cost, consumables and sludge disposal cost (including 2-year defect liability period covering manpower) 1st Year
